steps.what: Restock IV supplies and check materials against authorised preparation requirements
Add measured drugs or nutrients under sterile conditions to prepare IV packs
outputs: prepared IV packs for established checking process

tasks.design: Keep material checks and sterile preparation within the established pharmacy process. A {OTHER} specialist compounding robot is a separate validated equipment project; a records app cannot replace the physical preparation.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task requires controlled physical handling and equipment-specific validation.
tasks.enabler_now: Specialist robotic compounding exists, but its suitability is not established for this setting.
tasks.still_hard: Maintaining sterility and responding to material or process deviations.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising unsafe conditions and following the approved escalation route.
tasks.altitude: No change to sterile preparation duties or authority.

reach.task: Assess whether a validated equipment project suits the preparation mix
reach.learn: Which preparation types and checks the equipment actually supports

evidence.claim: OLVG uses APOTECAchemo for robotic cytostatic compounding; this does not establish that a software-only change replaces the current task.
This retained manual design claims no preparation-time reduction.

assumptions: Boundary is technician restocking and preparation; prescription authorisation and established independent checks remain outside and unchanged.
The existing authorised preparation process produces requirements upstream; no new structured recipe capture is introduced or treated as free.
s1 counts material gathering and checks. s2 counts physical preparation; no autonomous dosing or generated recipe is proposed.
No new system is introduced, so build and incremental upkeep are zero; a robot procurement is excluded from these estimates.
unknowns: Preparation mix, existing equipment and local authorised procedures
research_questions: Would validated specialist equipment reduce total preparation and checking effort for the actual case mix?

incremental.description: No new system or process upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 and R=35+65=100. Supply checks and sterile preparation retain their full time; no new upkeep or saving is assumed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supply and monitor medicine dispensing robots

steps.what: Check and supply robotic medicine dispensing machines with required stock and containers
Monitor robotic dispensing and labelling and address or escalate machine exceptions

tasks.design: Retain replenishment and monitoring through the existing {OTHER} dispensing-machine interface. The robot already performs dispensing and labelling; its runtime is not technician labour that a new dashboard can save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Machine automation does not remove stock loading or exception response.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing machine indicators support the technician, without establishing an additional saving.
tasks.still_hard: Wrong stock, jams and outputs requiring investigation under pharmacy procedures.
tasks.human_edge: Connecting machine messages with physical supplies and actual output.
tasks.altitude: No change to robot supply and monitoring responsibility.

reach.learn: What fault context permits reliable diagnosis

evidence.claim: Diakonessenhuis uses robots to fill medication rolls; existing robotic dispensing is distinct from new savings in supplying and monitoring them.

assumptions: Boundary includes only the technician's supply and monitoring work, not robot processing time or pharmacist release.
Existing machine controllers produce status and stock indicators through normal operation; their setup and current upkeep are unchanged and earn no saving.
s1 retains physical supply checks and loading; s2 retains monitoring and manual response when indicators are unclear.
No new structured exception coding, dashboard or upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Machine features, staffing requirements and current fault burden
research_questions: Is there separately measurable duplicate status checking beyond required machine supervision?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=60+40=100. Existing robot runtime is outside the labour denominator. Technician loading and monitoring remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Check medication or supply consignment and intended delivery recipient
Deliver medications or supplies and confirm handoff to intended recipient

tasks.design: Keep consignment checks, movement and handoff with the technician. Existing delivery details in {OTHER} pharmacy software can remain available, but no route-planning paperwork is invented to create an automation saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work is chiefly physical delivery and accountable handoff.
tasks.enabler_now: No validated replacement for that physical work is established in this design.
tasks.still_hard: Unreachable recipients, changed destinations and maintaining required transport conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising when the consignment cannot safely be handed over.
tasks.altitude: No change to delivery duties or handoff accountability.

reach.learn: How to arrange an authorised handoff without leaving supplies unattended

evidence.claim: Physical transport and recipient handoff remain human work in this retained workflow.

assumptions: Boundary starts with a prepared consignment; dispensing and recipient care are outside it and unchanged.
The existing dispatch process produces destination and recipient details; no structured address conversion or new capture is assumed.
s1 retains checks against actual consignment and instructions; s2 retains movement, exceptions and handoff.
No new system or ongoing upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Distances, destination types and current delivery arrangements
research_questions: Is there an actual repetitive coordination burden that can be separated from physical delivery?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=20+80=100. Checking and physical delivery retain their time, with no new upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain and merchandise home healthcare products

steps.what: Inspect home healthcare product stock displays and service information
Maintain and merchandise home healthcare products and approved service displays

tasks.design: Retain inspection and physical merchandising of home healthcare goods and approved service information. A {OTHER} stock screen may support existing work, but no stock feed replaces inspecting condition or arranging an accessible display.
tasks.previous_blocker: Merchandising depends on physical condition, available space and appropriate information.
tasks.enabler_now: No new digital capability has been shown to remove those actions.
tasks.still_hard: Keeping information appropriate and displays usable for the people served.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing whether a product or display is actually usable and suitable.

reach.task: Resolve suitability questions about healthcare product information
reach.learn: When a display message needs professional review

evidence.claim: This design retains physical inspection and merchandising rather than assuming a new content-production workload.

assumptions: Boundary is maintaining and merchandising existing products and services, excluding clinical advice and creating marketing campaigns.
s1 produces observed merchandising needs; approved information comes from the unchanged pharmacy approval process.
No structured stock deficit, par level or generated health claim is assumed.
No new system or upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Product range, display requirements and existing stock systems
research_questions: Is repeated label production a measured part of this task or already handled by existing software?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+60=100. Inspection and merchandising remain unchanged; no incremental upkeep or labour saving is claimed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain physical pharmacy operations with clear equipment and professional boundaries.
reach: Give pharmacists and equipment specialists clear observations
role.ambitious_version: Complete preparation, supply and delivery reliably within approved pharmacy processes.
